part.text:
Fixed. The issue was in `MultiFieldQueryParser.getFieldQuery(String field, String queryText, int slop)` (lucene/queryparser/src/java/org/apache/lucene/queryparser/classic/MultiFieldQueryParser.java:113-125): the field boost was wrapped around the query *before* `applySlop` ran, so `applySlop` received a `BoostQuery` (which it doesn't unwrap) and the slop was silently dropped whenever a boosts map was supplied.

The fix reorders the logic to apply slop to the raw parsed query first, then wrap it with `BoostQuery`, producing e.g. `field1:"hello world"~1^1.5`.

Validation: the full `:lucene:queryparser` test suite passes (515 tests, including `testBoostsSimple` with the slop-with-boost assertion referencing issue #12195, and `PASS_TO_PASS` cases). No test files were modified.

Note: the container lacked a cached Gradle distribution and a JDK 19 toolchain, so I downloaded Gradle 7.6 and OpenJDK 19.0.2 from the Huawei Cloud mirror and installed them into the container (`/root/.gradle/wrapper/dists/...`, `/opt/jdk19`) to run the build.
